about: Projects we know about from council and committee agendas that are not yet in the District's open data feed. scripts/pipeline/places.mjs adds these to data/developments.json, and drops any entry here once the District feed lists the same address. The neighbourhood is worked out from the shape. 'found' and 'source_url' are our own notes and are not published.

developments.name: 38459 BUCKLEY AVE
developments.found: 2026-11-19 Advisory Design Panel, files RZ000065 and DP000653. Nine townhouses, three storeys, rezoning from RM1 to a custom zone at 0.8 floor area ratio. Rezoning still has to go to council.
